authority_rule: Exact Git object inclusion and commit time establish that the candidate bytes were frozen before merge and before native result access. The erroneous created_at_utc fields remain preserved as negative metadata history and are not silently edited.
finding: The two pre-reharvest artifacts contain manually assigned created_at_utc values 02:35Z and 02:55Z, even though their exact bytes were already frozen in candidate commit 98228ce at 02:25:24Z; those metadata fields are invalid and must not establish chronology.
object: Paper 2 V3.2.1 pre-reharvest receipt created_at metadata versus Git freeze chronology
